headline: Extra virgin olive oil changes price from today in supermarkets: this is the situation at Mercadona, Carrefour, Consum, Dia and Alcampo
summary: Extra virgin olive oil prices changed on 6 October in Spanish supermarkets including Mercadona, Carrefour, Consum, Dia and Alcampo. The product remains one of the most expensive staples for consumers.
why: Olive oil is a major Spanish agricultural export, so retail prices reflect harvest conditions and producer costs that affect the agri-food sector.
